scope: numerical contract freeze only; no validation scoring

probe_grid.recurrence: append previous_center + 0.040 while that value < word_end - 1e-9
probe_grid.last_probe_center: append word_end when word_end - last_center > 1e-9; therefore the last center is the word end, including a shorter final grid step when needed
probe_grid.word_boundary_behavior: crop is centered at each grid point and may include context outside the word
probe_grid.utterance_edge_behavior: clip available waveform and zero-pad only the missing utterance-edge side

preprocessing.power_to_db: 10*log10(clamp(power,min=1e-10)); subtract per-sample maximum; clamp minimum to -80 dB

train_only_operation_priors.count_scope: clean expected-phone positions in usable TRAIN words; addition-containing, unresolved, malformed, or missing-boundary words excluded

span_contract.domain: every contiguous probe span [t,t+k) with integer k >= 1 and t+k <= T, subject only to existence of a complete monotonic path

SUBSTITUTION.alternative: q_star = argmax over q != e of A(S,q)
SUBSTITUTION.sustained_definition: mean competing-phone log probability across the complete assigned span; no majority, posterior, margin, or minimum-winning-probe rule

operation_scores.ADVANCE_TIME: structural only: increase k within the same contiguous emitted-phone span; no prior, continuation penalty, duration bonus, or duration penalty

dynamic_programming.state: DP[i,t] is the best score after consuming exactly the first i expected phones and first t probes

recurrence.MATCH: for every k>=1 with t+k<=T: DP[i+1,t+k] candidate = DP[i,t] + log_prior_MATCH + mean(L[t:t+k,E[i]])
recurrence.SUBSTITUTION: for every k>=1 with t+k<=T: choose q_star != E[i] by maximum mean L (lowest index on exact tie); DP[i+1,t+k] candidate = DP[i,t] + log_prior_SUB + mean(L[t:t+k,q_star])

dynamic_programming.relation_output: exactly one of correct, substitution, deletion per expected phone
dynamic_programming.substitution_output: q_star from the selected assigned span

ordered_resolution: for MATCH or SUBSTITUTION, shorter assigned span
for SUBSTITUTION, lower canonical q_star index
lower acoustic start index of the current predecessor transition
lexicographically smaller full operation-record sequence; each expected-position record is (operation_rank, probe_start, probe_end, q_star_or_-1), with MATCH=0, SUBSTITUTION=1, DELETE_EXPECTED=2

ambiguity.bookkeeping: deterministic exact k=2 complete-path bookkeeping where practical
ambiguity.path_identity: ordered expected-position records (operation_rank, probe_start, probe_end, q_star_or_-1)
ambiguity.numerically_ambiguous: second-best distinct complete path exists and path_score_gap <= 1e-8
ambiguity.selected_path: always the single path selected by tie_policy

interpretation.match_vs_substitution: generate both transitions; global DP chooses using frozen acoustic mean log evidence, TRAIN priors, and monotonic constraints; no threshold
interpretation.deletion: only a selected DELETE_EXPECTED transition in the globally optimal complete path; never inferred directly from duration, manual center, scalar margin, or MFA phone omission

hard_validation_gates_copied_unchanged.speaker_gate: for each validation speaker with >=30 deletions, deletion recall >=0.25

forbidden_inputs_and_tuning: manual observed phone as scorer input
MFA phone labels as observed truth
phone-, speaker-, duration-, or validation-specific costs
new neural training or R3 modification
